rationale: Executive Order 9669 (December 28, 1945) is a transfer of air-navigation facilities, property, functions and funds in Iran from the War Department to the Administrator of Civil Aeronautics, effective January 1, 1946. Executive Order 9709 (March 29, 1946; 11 FR 3389), whose Federal Register text is held, says in paragraph 6 that its provisions apply to the facilities, property and functions transferred by EO 9669, which order is superseded. The held 1989 Federal Register table and the catalog note agree (Superseded by: EO 9709, March 29, 1946), but the table is an editorial snapshot and I did not use it as a basis. The exact date the supersession took effect is not fixed by held sources, because paragraph 5 of EO 9709 ties effectiveness to per-location agreements, so only the lifecycle first end is left open; the status itself is not in doubt, since EO 9669 was a one-time transfer that EO 9709 superseded more than eighty years before 2026-10-14 and no held source revives it. The order has no operative force on 2026-10-14.
